title: 正確洗手五步驟與七字口訣科普教學 / Proper Handwashing Guide (5 Steps & 7 Key Gestures)
description: 4-segment comprehensive educational explainer storyboard for proper handwashing technique, featuring bilingual Context-IR prompts, slide infographic anchoring, dual-track phonetic dialogue, and anti-drift character continuity.

segments.display_dialogue: 病從口入，我們的手每天都會接觸成千上萬看不見的病原菌。正確洗手是守護健康最有效的第一道防線！

segments.title: Part 2 (6-14s): 洗手五步驟——濕搓沖捧擦 / Five Steps of Proper Handwashing
segments.display_dialogue: 正確洗手掌握五步驟「濕、搓、沖、捧、擦」：淋濕、肥皂起泡搓二十秒、清水沖淨、捧水沖洗水龍頭並完全擦乾！
